Find the right path for you! Below, you can check the different types of admissions available.  
  

### Regular Admission
All applicants fulfilling the general admission requirements and [language proficiency requirements](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) are eligible to apply as a regular admission.  
  

###  Admission With Scholarship
Admission with scholarship is only offered during the Early Admission period for the Fall Semester for current Grade 12 students who demonstrate excellent academic results during their last 3 years of high school.  
  
Excellent academic results are equivalent to an average ≥14 for all the majors, and ≥15 for Engineering and Architecture programs.  
  
You can check the various scholarships on offer based on your school grades through this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/scholarships-and-financial-aids).  
  
To apply for an admission scholarship, current Grade 12 students must upload their grades within the deadline mentioned on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).  
  
Applicants must sit for the English Proficiency Test and have a minimum English level equivalent to Level 2. Applicants who are assigned a Level 1 English remedial course must register in the Foundation Program first. Once completed, they can benefit from the scholarship offered, if any, during the first sophomore year. **Therefore, the scholarship is not applicable for the Foundation Program.**   
  
Once the results are published, the file will be sent for study for the scholarship eligibility and audit. Applicants will be informed of the decision by email.  
  
**PS: Candidates applying for an admission with scholarship cannot retake the entrance exams.**  
  

### Upgraded Admission with a Scholarship
Applicants who benefit from an excellence scholarship can get an upgrade in 3 cases:   
**  
a. Based on the official exams results:**   
- Applicants who pass the Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma with an average ≥17 for Lebanese Baccalaureate and ≥17 for the French Baccalaureate can benefit from a 75% scholarship upgrade, **provided that they apply during the Early Admission period and fulfill admission requirements.**  
- Applicants must provide their official baccalaureate grades once announced (unofficial transcript) **before the end of August to benefit from an upgrade.**   
**  
b. Based on Grade 12 ranking:**  
- Applicants who rank first by the end of Grade 12 can benefit from a 100% scholarship covering the whole program, provided that they meet the needed regulations and conditions. The scholarship does not cover registration and NSSF fees, as well as the Summer Session.   
- Applicants who rank second in class can benefit from a 50% excellence scholarship, valid for two consecutive semesters, provided that they meet the conditions. The excellence scholarship does not cover the registration, operational, and NSSF fees. as well as the Summer Session.  
- To benefit from the upgrade, the applicant must obtain a document issued by the school, mentioning their ranking in the final year transcript, and submit it to the Admissions Office.  
**  
c. Based on SAT scores:**   
- An additional 10% will be applied to the excellence scholarship for holders of SAT scores ≥1350.   
- Only students who applied during the Early Admission period and received an excellence scholarship can benefit from an additional percentage based on their SAT scores.   
  
**N.B: For any modifications to the submitted application and scholarship, candidates must send their requests by the end of June 2026 and their official exams results by the end of August 2026.**  
  

### Admission by file transfer 
Applicants who have previously studied at another university accredited by the Lebanese government or in a technical institute can apply as a transfer admission to check the potential transferrable courses.  
  
The documents required to apply as a transfer applicant are: 
  * a detailed description of the courses taken (specifying the number of credits and the number of hours per credit).
  * an official university transcript (including the total GPA).
  * the Lebanese Baccalaureate certificate or its equivalency.

  
Once the needed documents are submitted, the file will be sent for study and the candidate will be informed of the transfer decision as issued by USEK’s Admissions and Transfer Committee.

## Undergraduate
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-procedure?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-types?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/entrance-exam-samples?parent=1)
Find the right path for you! Below, you can check the different types of admissions available.  
  

### Regular Admission
All applicants fulfilling the general admission requirements and [language proficiency requirements](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) are eligible to apply as a regular admission.  
  

###  Admission With Scholarship
Admission with scholarship is only offered during the Early Admission period for the Fall Semester for current Grade 12 students who demonstrate excellent academic results during their last 3 years of high school.  
  
Excellent academic results are equivalent to an average ≥14 for all the majors, and ≥15 for Engineering and Architecture programs.  
  
You can check the various scholarships on offer based on your school grades through this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/scholarships-and-financial-aids).  
  
To apply for an admission scholarship, current Grade 12 students must upload their grades within the deadline mentioned on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).  
  
Applicants must sit for the English Proficiency Test and have a minimum English level equivalent to Level 2. Applicants who are assigned a Level 1 English remedial course must register in the Foundation Program first. Once completed, they can benefit from the scholarship offered, if any, during the first sophomore year. **Therefore, the scholarship is not applicable for the Foundation Program.**   
  
Once the results are published, the file will be sent for study for the scholarship eligibility and audit. Applicants will be informed of the decision by email.  
  
**PS: Candidates applying for an admission with scholarship cannot retake the entrance exams.**  
  

### Upgraded Admission with a Scholarship
Applicants who benefit from an excellence scholarship can get an upgrade in 3 cases:   
**  
a. Based on the official exams results:**   
- Applicants who pass the Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma with an average ≥17 for Lebanese Baccalaureate and ≥17 for the French Baccalaureate can benefit from a 75% scholarship upgrade, **provided that they apply during the Early Admission period and fulfill admission requirements.**  
- Applicants must provide their official baccalaureate grades once announced (unofficial transcript) **before the end of August to benefit from an upgrade.**   
**  
b. Based on Grade 12 ranking:**  
- Applicants who rank first by the end of Grade 12 can benefit from a 100% scholarship covering the whole program, provided that they meet the needed regulations and conditions. The scholarship does not cover registration and NSSF fees, as well as the Summer Session.   
- Applicants who rank second in class can benefit from a 50% excellence scholarship, valid for two consecutive semesters, provided that they meet the conditions. The excellence scholarship does not cover the registration, operational, and NSSF fees. as well as the Summer Session.  
- To benefit from the upgrade, the applicant must obtain a document issued by the school, mentioning their ranking in the final year transcript, and submit it to the Admissions Office.  
**  
c. Based on SAT scores:**   
- An additional 10% will be applied to the excellence scholarship for holders of SAT scores ≥1350.   
- Only students who applied during the Early Admission period and received an excellence scholarship can benefit from an additional percentage based on their SAT scores.   
  
**N.B: For any modifications to the submitted application and scholarship, candidates must send their requests by the end of June 2026 and their official exams results by the end of August 2026.**  
  

### Admission by file transfer 
Applicants who have previously studied at another university accredited by the Lebanese government or in a technical institute can apply as a transfer admission to check the potential transferrable courses.  
  
The documents required to apply as a transfer applicant are: 
  * a detailed description of the courses taken (specifying the number of credits and the number of hours per credit).
  * an official university transcript (including the total GPA).
  * the Lebanese Baccalaureate certificate or its equivalency.

  
Once the needed documents are submitted, the file will be sent for study and the candidate will be informed of the transfer decision as issued by USEK’s Admissions and Transfer Committee.

## Undergraduate
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-procedure?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-types?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/entrance-exam-samples?parent=1)
All undergraduate students must hold the Lebanese Baccalaureate or any other recognized diploma by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education, 30 credits of General Education courses and a minimum of 66 credits pertaining to the program of study. If not, candidates will be directed first to the [Freshman Program](https://www.usek.edu.lb/academics/freshman-program).   
  
There are 3 types of admission applicants at the undergraduate level:  
  
a- Freshman  
Students completing 12 years of schooling can apply to the Freshman level at USEK after getting the permit of study from the Equivalence Committee of the Lebanese Ministry of Education and Higher Education.  
  
b- Sophomore   
Students applying to the Sophomore year must have completed one of the following: 
  * 12 years of schooling and a Freshman program at USEK or any other recognized university.
  * 12 years of schooling and the Lebanese Baccalaureate, or any equivalent, recognized by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education.

  
c- Transfer  
Refer to section on Admission Tracks and Specific Requirements/Admission by File Transfer on the following [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-tracks?parent=1%20).  
  
Undergraduate candidates wishing to apply should complete the [Online Admission form](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and sit for the USEK entrance test(s), or present a valid SAT score, along with the following documents: 
  * A photocopy of the national identity card and/or of their valid passport, if any (for international students), or a copy of the individual civil status record.
  * A photocopy of the certified transcript for the last 3 high‐school classes (school and/or technical).
  * The Lebanese baccalaureate certificate or an equivalent degree, certified by the Lebanese Ministry of Education and Higher Education.

## Undergraduate
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-procedure?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-types?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/entrance-exam-samples?parent=1)
The online application for the spring semester will be active starting October 1st, 2025.  
  

### Exam dates for Regular Undergraduate Admission (all undergraduate programs except Engineering)
  * Wednesday November 12, 2025. (All programs Except Engineering) 
  * Friday December 5, 2025. (All programs Except Engineering) 
  * Monday January 19, 2025. (All programs including Engineering) 

  

### Dates for the Competitive Entrance Exam for Regular Undergraduate Admission (for Engineering programs)
  * Thursday November 20, 2025. 
  * Monday January 19, 2026. 

  

### Deadline for Admission by File Transfer
  * Thursday December 18, 2025. 

  
  

### Closure of the Online Application for the Spring Semester for the Regular Admission:
  * Tuesday January 6, 2026

  
  

### EXAM EXEMPTION
**English Proficiency Test Exemptions**  
Applicants who fit any of the conditions below are exempted from the English Proficiency Test:   

  * SAT with a score of 550/800 on the English section
  * Institutional Paper-Based TOEFL PBT with a score of 550/670.
  * Computer-Based TOEFL CBT with a score of 213/300.
  * Internet-based TOEFL IBT with a score of 80/120.
  * Cambridge First Certificate in English (now B2 First) with a score of C.
  * International English Language Testing System (IELTS) with a score of 6/9.

  
  
**French Remedial Exemptions**  
Applicants who fit any of the conditions below are exempted from USEK’s French Remedial Course: 
  * DELF B2 or TCF B2.
  * An average ≥10/20 in French (Grades 10 and 11).

  
  
**Program-Specific Exemptions**  
Applicants who fit any of the conditions below are exempted from program-specific requirements: 
  * Architecture Programs  
SAT (Reading and Writing + Math) ≥ 1200/1600, or USEK Math Entrance Exam ≥ 70/100
  * Business Programs  
SAT (Reading and Writing + Math) ≥ 1100/1600 or USEK Math Entrance Exam ≥ 70/100
  * Humanities and Art Programs  
SAT≥ 550/800 or Essay SAT ≥ 16/24
  * Engineering Programs  
SAT (Reading and Writing + Math) ≥ 1250/1600 (where Math ≥ 650) or USEK Engineering Entrance Exam ≥ 75/100
  * Agricultural Engineering – Engineering Sciences – Food Engineering  
SAT (Reading and Writing + Math) ≥ 1100/1600 or USEK Math Entrance Exam ≥ 70/100
  * Sciences Programs  
SAT (Reading and Writing + Math) ≥ 1100/1600 or USEK Math Entrance Exam ≥ 70/100

## Undergraduate
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-procedure?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-types?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/entrance-exam-samples?parent=1)
If you are currently a Grade 12 student or have already completed 12 years of schooling for the Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma recognized by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education, and you wish to enroll at USEK, please check below all the steps needed:  
**  
A. File submission**  
Step 1: Complete the [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and provide us with: 
  * A photocopy of the national identity card and/or photocopy of your valid passport (for international applicants) or a copy of the individual civil status record.
  * A photocopy of the transcript for the last 3 high-school classes.

  
You can check the requirements per program through this [link](https://netusekedu-my.sharepoint.com/my?viewid=5aca1c60%2De62a%2D4b41%2Da1fc%2Dda451723ac22&id=%2Fpersonal%2Fchantalibrahim%5Fusek%5Fedu%5Flb%2FDocuments%2FAdmissions%20Folder%2F2025%2D2026%2F202620%2FAPPLY%20202620%2FREQUIREMENTS%20%2D%20SCHOOL%20DIPLOMA%20202620%2Epdf&parent=%2Fpersonal%2Fchantalibrahim%5Fusek%5Fedu%5Flb%2FDocuments%2FAdmissions%20Folder%2F2025%2D2026%2F202620%2FAPPLY%20202620).  
  
Step 2: Choose a program and select a date for the on-campus [entrance exam](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1)
  * Regular Admission.
  * Admission with Scholarship. (only offered for current Grade 12 students during the Early Admission period for the Fall Semester)
  * Admission by File Transfer.

  
If you do not know which type of admission file you should apply for, you can get more info [here](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-tracks?parent=1).  
  
Step 3: Pay the non-refundable 30 USD admissions file fee at: 
  * One of the following banks: Audi, BLOM, BOB, Byblos
  * OMT (no additional fees)
  * BOB Finance (no additional fees)
  * Online payment by following this [URL](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/usek-admissions-applicant-online-payment/new?application_id_name=UNDERGRAD-APP-08236&academic_term_code=202610)

  
  
Step 4: Sit for an on-campus entrance exam (if any).  
  
**B. Results**  
Once the results are published, you will receive an email with a link to your results: 
  * You are eligible to retake the exam once only. If you wish to do so, you are requested to complete and submit the needed form through the link.**The exam retake fees amount to 15 USD.**
  * If you do not want to retake the exam and would like to confirm your choice of studies, you should log in to the [Apply Platform](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and submit your request. (You will receive a confirmation email). 

  
**PS: Candidates applying for an admission with scholarship cannot retake the entrance exams.  
  
C. File Completion**  
Once your records are activated and your program is confirmed, **you must complete your file with the hard copies** below within one month of the semester starts: 
  * A certified copy of your Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma.
  * A certified copy of your transcript during the last 3 years of high school.

  
  
**PS: If you fail to complete your file on time, an admissions hold will be placed on your records.  
**   
**D. Registration**  

  * Once your file is activated, you need to settle:  
The non-refundable deposit (200 USD) if you are applying as an early bird to be completed with the remaining payment before the semester starts.  
Or the full first payment (1000 USD) for the Regular Registration via OMT, BOB Finance, or at any Bank Audi, BLOM Bank, Bank of Beirut, or Byblos Bank branch or online by following this URL. 
  * Once activated, you will receive an email from the Enterprise IT Service Desk with your email address and password, along with instructions on how to reset your password and set up your email on your mobile.
  * You need to attend the Mandatory New Students Orientation Session on campus, in which expert help and advice will be at hand to assist you in registering for your courses using Banner Self Service. Dates and session details will be emailed to you and can also be found on the [USEK Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).

  
  

### Validity
Admission is valid for two consecutive semesters. Applicants who fail to register for one or two semesters during the academic year must submit a new application form.

##  Freshman 
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students)
The Freshman program at USEK is for students who are completing one of the following programs: 
  * The official American baccalaureate.
  * The IB Certificate.
  * IGCSE with O Levels.

  
  
You can either apply for Freshman Arts or Freshman Sciences, both requiring the completion of 30 credits over 2 consecutive semesters. Once completed, you can apply for the undergraduate program as a sophomore.  
  
To be eligible to apply as a freshman at USEK, you must complete the [online application form](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and submit the following documents: 
  * A photocopy of your identity card and/or passport (for international applicants) or a copy of the individual civil status record (for non-Lebanese applicants only).
  * A permit of study issued by the Equivalence Committee at the Lebanese Ministry of Education and Higher Education allowing you to join the Freshman program.
  * An SAT score of 870 for Freshman Arts and 950 for Freshman Sciences.

## Graduate
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-graduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-graduate-studies/dates-and-deadlines?parent=1)
### A. FILE SUBMISSION
**Step 1:** Complete the [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and submit it with the following documents: 
  * A photocopy of the national identity card and/or a photocopy of the passport (for international applicants), or a copy of the individual civil status record
  * A certified copy of university degree(s) equivalence(s) by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education in Lebanon.
  * Official transcript(s) covering all previous academic work.

  
**Step 2:** Choose a program, test date, and admission type (Regular or Transfer).  
  
**Step 3:** Pay the non-refundable 30 USD admissions file fees via OMT or BOB Finance, or at any Bank of Beirut, BLOM Bank, Bank Audi, Byblos Bank branch or online by following this [URL](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/usek-admissions-applicant-online-payment/new?application_id_name=UNDERGRAD-APP-08236&academic_term_code=202610).  
  
**Step 4:** Sit for an on-campus entrance exam (if needed).  
  

### B. RESULTS
  * You will receive an email with your results once published.
  * If you wish to confirm your choice of studies, you must log in to the [Apply Platform](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and submit your request.

  
  

### C. FILE COMPLETION
Once your records are activated and your program is confirmed, you must **complete your file with the hard copies** requested below within one month after the semester starts: 
  * A certified copy of your Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma.
  * A certified copy of your university diploma or its equivalence.
  * Your university transcript(s).

  
  
**PS: If you fail to complete your file on time, an admissions hold will be placed on your records.**  
  

### D. REGISTRATION
  * Once your file is activated, you need to settle:  
- The non-refundable deposit (200 USD) if you are applying as an early bird to be completed with the remaining payment before the semester starts.  
- Or the full first payment (1000 USD) for the Regular Registration via OMT, BOB Finance, or at any Bank Audi, BLOM Bank, Bank of Beirut, or Byblos Bank branch or online by following this [URL](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/usek-admissions-applicant-online-payment/new?application_id_name=UNDERGRAD-APP-08236&academic_term_code=202610).
  * Once activated, you will receive an email from the Enterprise IT Service Desk with your email address and password, along with instructions on how to reset your password and set up your email on your mobile. 
  * Attend the Mandatory New Students Orientation Session on campus, in which expert help and advice will be at hand to assist you in registering for your courses using Banner Self Service. **Dates and session details will be emailed to you and can also be found on the USEK[Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).**

## Undergraduate
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/requirements?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-procedure?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-types?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/entrance-exam-samples?parent=1)
If you are currently a Grade 12 student or have already completed 12 years of schooling for the Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma recognized by the Ministry of Education and Higher Education, and you wish to enroll at USEK, please check below all the steps needed:  
**  
A. File submission**  
Step 1: Complete the [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and provide us with: 
  * A photocopy of the national identity card and/or photocopy of your valid passport (for international applicants) or a copy of the individual civil status record.
  * A photocopy of the transcript for the last 3 high-school classes.

  
You can check the requirements per program through this [link](https://netusekedu-my.sharepoint.com/my?viewid=5aca1c60%2De62a%2D4b41%2Da1fc%2Dda451723ac22&id=%2Fpersonal%2Fchantalibrahim%5Fusek%5Fedu%5Flb%2FDocuments%2FAdmissions%20Folder%2F2025%2D2026%2F202620%2FAPPLY%20202620%2FREQUIREMENTS%20%2D%20SCHOOL%20DIPLOMA%20202620%2Epdf&parent=%2Fpersonal%2Fchantalibrahim%5Fusek%5Fedu%5Flb%2FDocuments%2FAdmissions%20Folder%2F2025%2D2026%2F202620%2FAPPLY%20202620).  
  
Step 2: Choose a program and select a date for the on-campus [entrance exam](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/calendar-of-admission-tests?parent=1)
  * Regular Admission.
  * Admission with Scholarship. (only offered for current Grade 12 students during the Early Admission period for the Fall Semester)
  * Admission by File Transfer.

  
If you do not know which type of admission file you should apply for, you can get more info [here](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies/admission-tracks?parent=1).  
  
Step 3: Pay the non-refundable 30 USD admissions file fee at: 
  * One of the following banks: Audi, BLOM, BOB, Byblos
  * OMT (no additional fees)
  * BOB Finance (no additional fees)
  * Online payment by following this [URL](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/usek-admissions-applicant-online-payment/new?application_id_name=UNDERGRAD-APP-08236&academic_term_code=202610)

  
  
Step 4: Sit for an on-campus entrance exam (if any).  
  
**B. Results**  
Once the results are published, you will receive an email with a link to your results: 
  * You are eligible to retake the exam once only. If you wish to do so, you are requested to complete and submit the needed form through the link.**The exam retake fees amount to 15 USD.**
  * If you do not want to retake the exam and would like to confirm your choice of studies, you should log in to the [Apply Platform](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) and submit your request. (You will receive a confirmation email). 

  
**PS: Candidates applying for an admission with scholarship cannot retake the entrance exams.  
  
C. File Completion**  
Once your records are activated and your program is confirmed, **you must complete your file with the hard copies** below within one month of the semester starts: 
  * A certified copy of your Lebanese Baccalaureate or an equivalent diploma.
  * A certified copy of your transcript during the last 3 years of high school.

  
  
**PS: If you fail to complete your file on time, an admissions hold will be placed on your records.  
**   
**D. Registration**  

  * Once your file is activated, you need to settle:  
The non-refundable deposit (200 USD) if you are applying as an early bird to be completed with the remaining payment before the semester starts.  
Or the full first payment (1000 USD) for the Regular Registration via OMT, BOB Finance, or at any Bank Audi, BLOM Bank, Bank of Beirut, or Byblos Bank branch or online by following this URL. 
  * Once activated, you will receive an email from the Enterprise IT Service Desk with your email address and password, along with instructions on how to reset your password and set up your email on your mobile.
  * You need to attend the Mandatory New Students Orientation Session on campus, in which expert help and advice will be at hand to assist you in registering for your courses using Banner Self Service. Dates and session details will be emailed to you and can also be found on the [USEK Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).

  
  

### Validity
Admission is valid for two consecutive semesters. Applicants who fail to register for one or two semesters during the academic year must submit a new application form.
