[1- Where can I find the credit prices and the payment procedure?](javascript:;)
Credit fees vary according to your program(s) of interest. You can check all the [fees](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/university-fees/undergraduate-studies-1) on the USEK website. As for the payment procedure, up until now, 70% of the tuition fees must be settled in fresh USD, and the remaining fees will be waived. Please note that the payment procedure is subject to change.
[2- Are candidates with an SAT score eligible to apply for a scholarship?](javascript:;)
SAT scores may exempt you from sitting for the English Proficiency Test and the program-specific exams only. You can check the [required scores per program](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) on the USEK website.
[3- Do candidates who get high grades on the official exams benefit from a scholarship?](javascript:;)
Candidates must apply first during the Early Admission period (February-April) to be eligible for upgrading their scholarship based on the official exams results at a later stage. All dates and deadlines are available on the USEK website.
[4- Am I eligible to apply for an admission with scholarship during the Spring Semester?](javascript:;)
Unfortunately, scholarships are valid only if you apply directly for the Fall Semester after graduating from school.
[5- What is the admissions procedure to apply to USEK?](javascript:;)
You must submit your [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) available on the USEK website: and attach the [required documents](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) so that we can check your eligibility accordingly.
[6- What are the required study materials for the entrance exam(s)?](javascript:;)
You can send an email to admissions@usek.edu.lb and we will be sending you the required chapters and samples accordingly.
[7- How does the Hybrid education system work?](javascript:;)
USEK follows the American credit system. Some programs are purely offered in English, while others can be hybrid (with some courses in French and others English depending on the program and the course offering for each semester).
[8- Can English-educated candidates apply for a hybrid program?](javascript:;)
Yes, you can, However, you may still need to validate French remedial courses and communication skills. Since some courses may be offered solely in French, proficiency in this language could be essential for a successful experience within hybrid programs.
[9- What are the requirements to register as a Freshman student?](javascript:;)
To apply for the Freshman program, you must submit a permit of study, your school diploma, and a minimum SAT score of 1000. You can submit your [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) on the [USEK website](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) and attach the required documents and we will check your eligibility accordingly.
[10- Can I register as a Freshman student if I fail the official exams?](javascript:;)
Candidates who fail the official exams are not eligible to apply for the Freshman program. Once their exams passed, they can re-apply as sophomore. You can check your eligibility to apply as a freshman student via this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/freshman).
[11- What is the procedure to reactivate my file?](javascript:;)
If you activated your account but did not register for any courses, you must send an email to admissions@usek.edu.lb. However, if you register for any courses, you must to submit a Readmission request to the Office of the Registrar within the deadlines set on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[12- What if I am unable to attend the orientation session?](javascript:;)
The orientation session is mandatory and is very helpful to ensure a smooth registration process. However, if you cannot attend it, please refer to the Students Affairs Office at: sao@usek.edu.lb.
[13- Can I take my entrance exams online?](javascript:;)
Entrance exams are held only on campus, not online. You can reschedule your exam to another date, if available.
[14- How can I submit a transfer request if I have an LT degree?](javascript:;)
Only a TS degree can be taken into consideration if you have a grade average of 12 and above. You can submit your [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) on the [USEK website](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) and attach the required documents so that we can check your eligibility accordingly.
[15- What are the consequences of breaching my contract with Notre Dame de Secours (NDS) University Hospital?](javascript:;)
As mentioned in the signed contract, you must repay all your tuition fees if you decide to breach the contract. For more info: accountsreceivable@usek.edu.lb.
[16- What is the admissions procedure for submitting a transfer request to USEK?](javascript:;)
To initiate the process, you must submit your [online application](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications) on the [USEK website](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/online-admission-requirements) and attach the required documents so that we can check your eligibility accordingly. Subsequently, we will conduct a thorough study of your file to determine the transferability of courses.   
  
Please note that a maximum of 49% of your credits can be considered for transfer.   
  
Details about transferred courses cannot be provided in advance as they are contingent on the file study decision.
[17- Can I apply for two majors at the same time?](javascript:;)
You can activate one program only through the Admissions Office. However, as an active USEK student, you can later submit a double major request at the Office of the Registrar at registrar@usek.edu.lb within the deadlines mentioned on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[18- Are USEK degrees recognized?](javascript:;)
Your USEK degree allows you to apply to master programs in other national universities. However, each university has its own admissions requirements; hence, it is preferable to refer to your university of interest.
[19- Can I defer my admission after I have been accepted?](javascript:;)
Your acceptance is valid for two consecutive semesters only. You can postpone it to the consecutive semester only without having to submit the online application again. However, if you do not register at all during the Fall and Spring semesters, you will have to submit a new application form to be studied again according to the admission conditions.
[20- Does USEK offer online certificates?](javascript:;)
You can refer to the [USEK Continuing Learning Center](https://www.usek.edu.lb/uclc) (UCLC) on the USEK website or send an email at: uclc@usek.edu.lb.

[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/alumni?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/career-center?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/financial-aid?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/registrar?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/information-technology?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/counseling-and-accessibility-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/student-affairs-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/international-affairs?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/library?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/eits?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/sports-department?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/national-social-security-fund?parent=1)
[1- Do you have a sample CV that I can use?](javascript:;)
Yes, you can request a sample CV from the CSO team. For additional assistance in writing your CV, email us at careers@usek.edu.lb to schedule a meeting.
[2- How can I schedule an advisory appointment?](javascript:;)
To book an advisory appointment, simply send an email to careers@usek.edu.lb.
[3- If I am seeking an internship, can you assist me?](javascript:;)
Certainly! Send us an email at careers@usek.edu.lb with your preferences, and we will promptly respond to help you find a suitable internship.
[4- Where can I find updates on the latest job openings?](javascript:;)
Job openings, when received, are directly posted on our [Simplicity platform](https://usek-csm.symplicity.com/students/index.php?signin_tab=0)
[5- I have a job interview tomorrow. Can you help?](javascript:;)
Absolutely! To receive assistance, book an advisory appointment by emailing us at careers@usek.edu.lb.
[6- Can you help me with my LinkedIn profile?](javascript:;)
Certainly! For LinkedIn profile assistance, please email us at careers@usek.edu.lb, and we will guide you through the process.
[7- How can I create or enhance my professional portfolio?](javascript:;)
For guidance on creating or enhancing your professional portfolio, check with your faculty or dean, who can provide specific insights tailored to your academic field.
[8- Where can I obtain the internship application form?](javascript:;)
You can obtain it from the Office of the Registrar.

[1- How can I log into e-learning?](javascript:;)
From your preferred web browser, navigate to [USEK’s e-Learning](https://elearning.usek.edu.lb) page.   
  
To log in, enter your student ID number and password (the same password used for your e-mail), then click on “Log in”.  
  
For the best experience, Google Chrome and Mozilla Firefox are recommended.
[2- What if I cannot find my courses on e-Learning?](javascript:;)
First, double-check that you confirmed all the courses enrolled during the “Initial Registration” period on Banner. The registration status of the course must indicate “Final Registration”; otherwise, your course status will remain “Initial Registration” and will be automatically dropped after the confirmation of the “Initial Registration” period.  
Upon course confirmation, you need to wait 24 hours for the synchronization process to finish, then your courses will show up on your dashboard on e-Learning.  
  
The dashboard has course filters: All, In Progress, Future, Past, Starred and Removed. Therefore, you may need to adjust the filters on the dashboard to locate specific courses.   
  
If you are still facing issues, please contact us on elearning@usek.edu.lb.  

[3- What is the maximum upload file size for an assignment on e-learning?](javascript:;)
It depends. For each assignment, your instructor can specify the maximum size of the uploaded file, as well as its type. You can find the maximum size for an uploaded file above the upload box.
[4- How do my old courses disappear from e-Learning?](javascript:;)
Your courses will remain available on e-Learning for 3 academic years. After that, you will no longer be able to find or access them.
[5- How do I change/reset my password?](javascript:;)
To reset your password, follow the steps on this [WIKI page](https://wiki.usek.edu.lb/en/service-desk/faq/change-password).  
  
The new password will be required to access all USEK services (MyUSEK, Banner, e-Learning, Office365 applications including the USEK email, Wi-Fi, etc.).   
  
If you encounter any issues, please send an email to it.servicedesk@usek.edu.lb requesting a password reset. A service ticket will be automatically submitted. Make sure to include your student ID number, an attachment of your ID or passport, and your USEK email.  
  
If you are on campus, you can visit our EITS User Support Office located at Building A, Room AC001.
[6- How can I log into Banner?](javascript:;)
Navigate to [MyUSEK Banner Page](https://myusek.usek.edu.lb/banner-sis) and click on “Go to Banner Student Self Service”. When prompted to enter your credentials to login, fill in your student ID and your USEK account password, then click “Continue”.
[7- How can I configure my USEK email to my phone?](javascript:;)
Follow this [WIKI guide](https://wiki.usek.edu.lb/service-desk/usek-email) to set up your USEK email on your phone.
[8- Where can I check my amount due?](javascript:;)
To check your amount due, log in to [MyUSEK](https://myusek.usek.edu.lb/login#login) with your USEK ID and password. Under ‘Student Services’, click on ‘Amount Due’. Follow this [WIKI guide](https://wiki.usek.edu.lb/service-desk/faq/student-amount-due) for more details.
[9- How can I install MS Office on my device?](javascript:;)
For Windows users:   
Visit the official [Microsoft Office website](http://www.office365.com), sign in with your USEK account (a Microsoft 365 account), and download the Office setup file. Run the installer and follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.  
  
For iOS users:  
Navigate to the App Store and search for ‘Microsoft 365 (Office)’. This app includes essential tools such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Alternatively, you can search for specific applications like ‘Microsoft Word’. Tap on 'Get' to begin the installation. Once installed, open the app and sign in using your Microsoft account to unlock all features.

# Students
[](javascript:;)
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/registration)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Content/Assets/20250901SJM-125021.pdf)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Site/ListingBlocks.aspx?pageid=2780)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/scholarships-and-financial-aids)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/student-voice)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/student-support-offices)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/academics/ltec/diversity-and-inclusion)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/university-fees/undergraduate-studies-1)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/usek-writing-center/mission)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/prospective-students/why-choose-usek)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/umc)
## Frequently Asked Questions
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/alumni?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/career-center?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/financial-aid?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/registrar?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/information-technology?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/counseling-and-accessibility-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/student-affairs-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/international-affairs?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/library?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/eits?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/sports-department?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/national-social-security-fund?parent=1)
[1- If I would like to study abroad, what should I do?](javascript:;)
There are two ways for you to study abroad:  
- Join an exchange program: Within this exchange program, you register in courses at USEK and spend one semester or one year in one of our partner universities. You should cover your tuition fees at USEK and benefit from a fee waiver at the host university. Your courses at USEK will be graded upon your return based on the grades you acquired at the host university. Please note that you cannot earn a degree from the host university.  
- Apply for a full degree awarding program abroad: Applying to a full program abroad is beyond the scope of USEK’s partnerships, since you should apply on an individual basis for a university of your choice. Applications are to be submitted online to the host university in accordance with its own procedures in force (All needed details are to be checked on the website of the host university).
[2- How can I choose a destination for a mobility program?](javascript:;)
There are two types of student mobility programs:  
  
Funded mobility programs by ERASMUS+: With this scholarship, you will benefit from the ticket fees and an allowance between 650 and 800 euros per month (This exchange program is highly competitive; selection interviews will be conducted to choose proper candidates). For an updated list of available funded scholarships, please contact us.  
  
Non-Funded mobility programs: With this mobility type, you should cover your personal expenses and the ticket fees. You can find all the universities listed on our [map of international collaborations](https://www.usek.edu.lb/internation/map-international-collaborations).
[3- How can I apply for a mobility program?](javascript:;)
To apply, you should follow the steps below:  
  
I. Confirm your eligibility with your advisor considering the following criteria:  
Undergraduate students: 
  * GPA: over 75 recommended
  * Number of validated credits: minimum of 30 credits

  
Graduate students: 
  * GPA: over 80 recommended
  * Number of validated credits: minimum of 9 to 12 credits

  
II. Refer to the host university’s course catalogue (can be found online) and go through it carefully to find suitable courses to attend. Your advisor can assist you in this regard.  
  
III. Once you have found courses that would match your curriculum, you can proceed with submitting an Outgoing Mobility Request.
[4- Can I still benefit from a protocol scholarship while on a mobility program?](javascript:;)
You should refer to Protocol Scholarship terms and regulations, as such inquiries are handled on case-by-case basis.
[5- How can I benefit from and apply for the International Students Scholarship Program?](javascript:;)
International students residing outside Lebanon as well as students with Lebanese origin residing abroad are eligible to apply, whereas binational students residing in Lebanon are not.  
  
In addition, the scholarship covers full tuition fees for bachelor or master programs (excluding remedial courses). Application fees, registration fees per semester, travel to/from Lebanon, dorms and living expenses are to be covered by the applicant.  
Interested students should submit the required documents by email.   
  
Please visit our website to check the application, required documents, and deadlines for each semester.
[6- What should I do in case I want to apply for a full program abroad?](javascript:;)
Applying for a new program is beyond the scope of USEK’s partnerships with international universities. However, the list of agreements might help you select your destination. You can access our Map of International Collaborations where you will find the agreements listed and divided by Faculty/School.   
  
You can also access the links below which will assist you in your search:  
International scope: 
  * [MastersPortal](https://www.mastersportal.com/)
  * [ERASMUS Scholarships](https://www.eacea.ec.europa.eu/grants_en)

  
France: (Visa procedure is to be undertaken through Campus France) 
  * Scholarships to Master programs in France:   
- [Campus France](https://campusbourses.campusfrance.org/#/catalog?lang=fr)  
- [France Diplomatie](https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/venir-en-france/etudier-en-france/financer-son-projet-d-etudes-en-france/#sommaire_1)
  * [EIFFEL Scholarship](https://www.daad.de/en/study-and-research-in-germany/scholarships/)

  
Germany: 
  * [DAAD Scholarships](https://www.daad.de/en/study-and-research-in-germany/scholarships/)

[1- How can I join any USEK sports team?](javascript:;)
To become a part of our sports teams, you must participate in the tryouts. The coach will assess your performance during the tryouts to determine your skill level. Tryouts opportunities and schedules are announced on our social media channels (Instagram: USEK Official, or USEK sports / Facebook page: USEK Sports Teams).
[2- When are the tryouts scheduled?](javascript:;)
Usually, tryouts are conducted at the beginning of the Fall Semester, specifically during the 2nd or 3rd week of September. Dates are announced on our social media platforms.
[3- Are tryouts conducted during the Spring Semester?](javascript:;)
Tryouts are not usually called for during the Spring Semester. However, they may be held in spring if the coach requests it, especially if a player graduates or leaves the team.
[4- Am I eligible and how do I benefit from a scholarship if I join any sports team?](javascript:;)
Yes, you do benefit from a scholarship if you join any of our sports teams starting the 2nd semester of your commitment with the team.
[5- What is the maximum percentage of scholarship granted to athletes?](javascript:;)
Our sports scholarship ranges from 10% to 40% (starting Fall Semester 2025-2026).
[6- How is my scholarship percentage calculated?](javascript:;)
The percentage is granted based on the coach’s assessment, taking into consideration your performance, commitment to training and games, and other relevant criteria.
[7- What sports are available at USEK?](javascript:;)
USEK currently has 11 teams in basketball (men and women), volleyball (men and women), futsal (men and women), Handball (men and women), tennis (mixed), table tennis (mixed), chess, track and field, badminton, swimming, and cheerleading.
[8- Will my scholarship be forfeited if I am placed on probation?](javascript:;)
Yes, you will lose your scholarship if your cumulative GPA falls below 70/100 for undergraduate students or below 80/100 graduate students.
[9- What kinds of competitions do USEK sports teams take part in?](javascript:;)
Our teams primarily participate in the Lebanese University league, which is organized by the Lebanese Federation of University Sport (FSUL). We may also take part in international leagues if such opportunities arise.
[10- Do you have any social media platforms where I can follow your updates and posts?](javascript:;)
You can follow us on:  

  * Facebook: [USEK Sports Teams](https://www.facebook.com/USEKSportsTeams)
  * Instagram: [USEKsportsteams](https://www.instagram.com/useksportsteams?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==)


[11- How do I book sports facilities?](javascript:;)
To reserve the court/table tennis section, please send an email to sports@usek.edu.lb, specifying your preferred day and time.
[12- Can I use your equipment?](javascript:;)
Once your reservation of the court/table tennis section is approved by the Sports Department, and if you intend to use USEK equipment, please visit the Student Affairs office (AC003) to sign the Sports Equipment Rules before your reservation.
[13- Is it possible to request the creation of a new team?](javascript:;)
If you wish to establish a new team alongside our existing ones, please contact the Sports Department at sports@usek.edu.lb to discuss eligibility and the necessary steps.

# Students
[](javascript:;)
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/admission/for-undergraduate-studies)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/registration)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Content/Assets/20250901SJM-125021.pdf)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Site/ListingBlocks.aspx?pageid=2780)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/scholarships-and-financial-aids)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/student-voice)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/student-support-offices)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/academics/ltec/diversity-and-inclusion)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/university-fees/undergraduate-studies-1)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students/usek-writing-center/mission)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/prospective-students/why-choose-usek)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/umc)
## Frequently Asked Questions
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/alumni?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/career-center?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/financial-aid?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/registrar?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/information-technology?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/counseling-and-accessibility-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/student-affairs-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/international-affairs?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/library?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/eits?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/sports-department?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/national-social-security-fund?parent=1)
[1- How can I submit a petition? ](javascript:;)
You can send an email at sao@usek.edu.lb, clearly explaining your request and mentioning your student ID, the course code, and CRN. The petition process might take up to 5 working days.
[2- How can we resolve a time conflict between 2 finals/midterms?](javascript:;)
You can send an email at sao@usek.edu.lb, stating the CRN and timing of each exam and we will help address the issue.
[3- Is there a university residence on campus?](javascript:;)
The University Residence is located on campus in Kaslik and is available for female residents only. We can also help by providing a list of residences near the University for male students.  
  
To book a room at the University Residence, you can send an email to residence@usek.edu.lb, specifying the type of room and your contact information.
[4- Can I borrow a laptop/board games/sport equipment for a few hours?](javascript:;)
You can pass by the SAO to request to borrow laptop/board games/sport equipment for a specific period.
[5- How can I report bullying on campus?](javascript:;)
We encourage you to report any bullying by email at sao@usek.edu.lb or pass by the SAO to explain what happened, noting that any reporting will remain confidential.
[6- Can I participate in the commencement ceremony if I have a few credits left?](javascript:;)
If you are near the end of your academic path with only a few credits remaining, you can take part in the commencement ceremony, especially if your remaining credits are scheduled to be completed during the Summer Session.
[7- How do I apply for a student job, and what is the process for acceptance?](javascript:;)
To apply for a student job, email the SAO at sao@usek.edu.lb to express your interest. Your name will be added to the waiting list and our team will inform you how to proceed once a vacancy is available.
[8- How do I get involved in student clubs/talent programs?](javascript:;)
So far, we have 10 active clubs on campus. If you would like to join a club, contact one of its officers or send us an email. And if you would like to suggest and initiate a new club, please scan this QR code as a first step and fill out the form.   
  
As for the talent program, once this program is open to all students, we will send an email with a link where you need to fill out a form and send a video demonstrating your talent within the timeframe stated in the email.

[1- How and when should I apply for financial aid?](javascript:;)
If you want to apply for financial aid, please check the FAO services section on this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/student-service-offices/financial-aid-office).
[2- Do I need to apply for financial aid each year?](javascript:;)
The Financial Aid Application is valid for one academic cycle. If you switch to a different degree program or academic level, you will need to submit a new application to remain eligible.
[3- What documents are required to apply for financial aid? ](javascript:;)
To apply for Financial Aid, please print and complete the application form and gather the necessary documents from this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Content/Assets/20250124FinancialAidForm-091759.pdf). Your privacy is important - your personal data will be kept confidential.
[4- Am I eligible for financial aid?](javascript:;)
To check your eligibility for financial aid, please refer to the FAO services section on this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/student-service-offices/financial-aid-office).
[5- Can I benefit from multiple discounts?](javascript:;)
If you are granted another type of discount in addition to financial aid, the Financial Aid Review Committee (FARC) will determine the total reduction amount based on your socioeconomic situation and in line with the USEK regulations.
[6- Can I pay my tuition fees in monthly installments?](javascript:;)
Students must adhere to the payment schedule set by the University. After settling the initial registration payment, the remaining balance is divided into 3 payments per semester. Payment deadlines are specified in the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[7- Can I pay all the full fees for the semester in one installment?](javascript:;)
You can send an email at fao@usek.edu.lb or visit our office (Block AC – Ground Floor) to discuss your case.
[8- Does my financial aid discount percentage change from year to year?](javascript:;)
The financial aid percentage is reviewed at the beginning of each semester. If unexpected circumstances arise or significant changes occur in your financial situation, you may submit an appeal to re-evaluate your case in light of the new conditions.  
_  
Disclaimer: Please be advised that this discount is not binding and may be subject to review for administrative consideration as deemed necessary._
[9- Is financial aid available for students applying for international exchange? ](javascript:;)
Students enrolled at USEK maintain their discount even during an international exchange semester coordinated by the International Affairs Office (IAO).
[10- If my brother/sister and I are simultaneously registered at USEK, can we benefit from a reduction on our tuition fees?](javascript:;)
Yes. Siblings enrolled simultaneously at USEK can benefit from the siblings’ allowance. For more details, please check the FAO services section on this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/student-service-offices/financial-aid-office).
[11- As siblings, do we need to submit separate Financial Aid Application forms?](javascript:;)
While all siblings benefit from the Siblings Allowance, only one sibling is eligible to receive the Financial Aid discount.
[12- I am a relative of an OLM member. How can I benefit from a discount?](javascript:;)
If you are a brother/sister or nephew/niece of an OLM member, you can apply for a specific discount. For more details, please check the FAO services section on this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/student-service-offices/financial-aid-office).
[13- Which additional discounts are available?](javascript:;)
You can explore all available discounts in the “Reductions and Agreements” section under [Scholarships and Financial Aid](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/scholarships-and-financial-aids).
[14- I probably do not qualify for financial aid. Should I apply anyway?](javascript:;)
Yes. To be considered for financial aid, please submit an application. The committee will review your file and determine your eligibility.
[15- Do I need to be admitted before I can apply for financial aid?](javascript:;)
Yes. Only students enrolled at USEK can submit a Financial Aid Application.
[16- Should my parents attend the financial aid meeting with the social worker?](javascript:;)
It’s optional. You or your parents can decide, knowing that their presence is not required if you can answer the questions yourself.
[17- How is the financial aid discount applied (on which part of the tuition fees)?](javascript:;)
Financial aid applies to the full tuition fees, except the registration/operational and NSSF fees.
[18- How is the financial aid discount determined and what is the maximum percentage?](javascript:;)
Financial aid is a need-based discount. The percentage is determined by the Financial Aid Review Committee according to your socioeconomic situation.
[19- Is the financial aid discount applicable during the Summer Session?](javascript:;)
No. Financial aid discounts are not applicable during the Summer Session.

## Frequently Asked Questions
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions)
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/alumni?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/career-center?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/financial-aid?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/registrar?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/information-technology?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/counseling-and-accessibility-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/student-affairs-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/international-affairs?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/library?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/eits?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/sports-department?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/national-social-security-fund?parent=1)
[1- How and when should I register for classes? ](javascript:;)
To register for the upcoming semesters, you should proceed with your course registration within the dates of the “Initial Registration” specified on the Academic Calendar online via Banner Self-service by following the steps below:  
usek.edu.lb – Quick Links – Banner – Enter Secure Area – Registration – Add or Drop classes – Select the term  
  
Please insert the CRNs in the empty boxes (the CRNs are available in the course offering on the USEK website). You can consult your academic advisor about the required courses prior to the registration period, then click on “Submit”.  
  
If any problem occurs while registering a course, you can submit an “Override Request ”.  
  
You can drop or confirm and add your courses within the specified dates under “Registration Verification and Validation” and “Late Registration” on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[2- How do I withdraw from a course?](javascript:;)
You can send an email to the Office of the Registrar within the specified deadlines on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[3- What is the minimum/maximum number of credits I can register?](javascript:;)
For the Fall and Spring Semesters: 
  * Undergraduates (full-time students): 12 to 18 credits
  * Graduates (full-time students): 6 to 12 credits
  * Students under probation: 12 to 13 credits

  
  
For the Summer Session: 
  * Undergraduates and Graduates: 1 to 6 credits


[4- What is Add/Drop and how does it work?](javascript:;)
Once the registration period ends, you can modify your registration during the Add/Drop period. To do so, you can add or drop any desired course online, noting that no courses can be dropped during the Late Registration period for the Summer Session.  
  
If you could not register within the set deadlines, you can undergo Late Registration during the Add/Drop period, but penalty fees will apply.
[5- How do I override into a course? ](javascript:;)
You can submit your registration override requests for the ongoing semester as follows:  
1. Login in to MyUSEK Platform and go to the Student Services Workspace.  
2. In the Student Requests section, select the Registration Override Request 202330 form.  
3. Add a new registration override request and fill in the required information by following the instructions shown on top of the page.   
4. Save your progress and submit the request once done (requests in Draft status will NOT be processed).   
  
Capacity overrides will not be processed through this form. For very exceptional issues related to class capacity, you must refer to your academic advisor(s).  
  
You will first receive an email confirming that the request has been submitted, followed by another email indicating if the request has been accepted or rejected. If your request is accepted, it does not mean that you have been added to the class; you will have to add the course yourself.
[6- How can I request a copy of my grade transcript or diploma?](javascript:;)
You or any person can initiate a request at the Office of the Registrar or submit a request by email at: registrar@usek.edu.lb.  
  
You will receive an email to notify you once the document is ready. Document fees must be settled at the Students Accounting Desk. You may delegate a third party to retrieve the requested documents by sending an email.
[7- How do I know if I am all set to graduate?](javascript:;)
You must contact your academic advisor before every registration to check your academic progress.
[8- How can I change my program?](javascript:;)
If you wish to request a change of major or emphasis during your studies, you can submit a request at the Office of the Registrar within the deadlines set on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar). You have the right to change your major or emphasis only twice.
[9- Where can I see my course offerings for the upcoming semester?](javascript:;)
The course offerings for upcoming semesters are published online before the Registration period.
[10- What are the procedures of interruptions and re-admissions?](javascript:;)
If you wish to suspend or resume your studies at USEK, you must submit your request by email to the Office of the Registrar within the specified deadlines on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).  
  
If you are registered in a specific term and can no longer pursue your studies for major reasons, such as serious health problems or exceptional family circumstances, the grade WW (Term Withdraw) can be assigned to each course.  
  
To obtain a Term Withdrawal, you must submit the Interruption of Studies and Term Withdrawal requests by email to the Office of the Registrar. An Interruption of Studies can only be granted once during your studies at the University and tuition fees must be settled as calculated upon registration.
[11- How many consecutive interruptions can I have before being set out of program?](javascript:;)
You can benefit from an Interruption of Studies only once during your studies at the University.  
  
If the interruption lasts less than two years, you can apply for automatic re‐admission to your major after submitting a Re-admission Request.  
  
However, if you interrupted your studies for more than two years and wish to pursue your education at USEK, you should submit a Re‐admission Request to the Office of the Registrar and the previously earned courses will be subject to re‐assessment.
[12- Where can I see my Holds? ](javascript:;)
To check the holds, you will have to log into the Banner Self Service and follow the steps below:  
Banner Student Self Service – Account Summary – View Holds
[13- What if I disagree with a grade?](javascript:;)
You have the right to ask, within the deadlines set on the Academic Calendar, for your course final grade to be re-checked by sending an email at gradereview@usek.edu.lb. You can ask for two grades at the most to be reviewed per semester or during the Summer Session. If the request is approved, your grade will be revised on your Banner account. If no changes are applied, the processing fees will be automatically charged to your account.
[14- Is there a minor program at USEK?](javascript:;)
Reserved for undergraduate studies with specific objectives defined according to each field, academic minors are achieved through a set of structured courses, not necessarily related to one discipline. Minors are expected to provide students with basic knowledge and primary competencies.  
  
For more information, please refer to this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/minors/what-is-minor).
[15- How are students considered for scholarships?](javascript:;)
Merit scholarships are calculated at the end of each Fall and Spring Semesters. (currently not being applied!)   
  
For more information, please refer to this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/student-service-offices/registrar-office-1/merit-scholarship-regulations?parent=1).

### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/admissions?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/alumni?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/career-center?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/financial-aid?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/registrar?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/information-technology?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/counseling-and-accessibility-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/student-affairs-office?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/international-affairs?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/library?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/eits?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/sports-department?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/students/frequently-asked-questions/national-social-security-fund?parent=1)
[1- How can I log into e-Learning? ](javascript:;)
From your preferred web browser, navigate to this link to reach [USEK’s e-Learning](https://elearning.usek.edu.lb/) page. For the best experience, Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox are recommended. Insert your student ID number and password (same password used for your e-mail, Wi-Fi, and many other services), and click “Log in”.
[2- What if I cannot find my courses on e-Learning?](javascript:;)
First, double-check that you confirmed all your pre-registered courses on Banner.   
  
In other terms, the registration status of the course must indicate “Complete Registration”; otherwise, your course’s status will remain “Early Registration” and will be automatically dropped after the “Confirmation of the Early Registration” period.  
  
Upon course confirmation, you need to wait 24 hours for the synchronization process to finish, then your courses will show up on your dashboard on e-Learning.  
  
The dashboard has course filters: All, In Progress, Future, Past, Starred and Removed. Hence, you might not be able to find a previous course or a course removed from view unless you change your filters. If you are still facing issues, you may report your issue by email.
[3- What is the maximum upload file size for an assignment on eLearning?](javascript:;)
It depends. For each assignment, your instructor can specify the maximum size of the uploaded file, as well as its type. As a student, the maximum size for an uploaded file can be found above the upload box.
[4- Do my old courses disappear from -Learning?](javascript:;)
Your courses will remain available on e-Learning for 3 years. After that, you can neither find them nor access them.
[5- How do I change/reset my password?](javascript:;)
To reset your password, please follow the steps found on [this WIKI page](https://wiki.usek.edu.lb/en/service-desk/faq/change-password).   
If you encounter any issue while setting up your new password, please send an email to it.servicedesk@usek.edu.lb requesting a password reset. Please include your student ID number and your email in such requests.   
The new password will be required to gain access to all USEK services (e.g., Wi-Fi, e-mail, Banner, e-learning, etc.).
[6- How can I log into Banner?](javascript:;)
From your preferred web browser, navigate to this [link](https://self.usek.edu.lb/) to reach USEK’s Banner self-service homepage. For the best experience, Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox are recommended. Click on “Enter Secure Area” to reach the webpage where you can input your student ID and password, then click “Log in”.
[7- How to configure my USEK email to my phone?](javascript:;)
You can follow [this WIKI guide](https://wiki.usek.edu.lb/service-desk/usek-email) to setup your USEK email on your phone.

[1. Am I entitled to have a USEK Library account? ](javascript:;)
All USEK students, faculty, staff, and courtesy borrowers (alumni and visitors) who have current USEK identification cards are entitled to borrow items from the USEK Library. Make sure you have your USEK card with you for checking out and renewing items. Please note that your card cannot be used by anyone else.
[2- How do I renew items I wish to keep for a longer period?](javascript:;)
Items borrowed from the USEK Library may be renewed for an additional term depending on the type of item and the loan period. Items will not be renewed if: 
  * the item is on hold by another user; 
  * the item is placed on course reserve;
  * the borrower’s ID is blocked; 
  * the loan has already been renewed twice; 
  * the item has been recalled by the Library.


[3- Can I copy/print/scan (CPS) documents in the Library?](javascript:;)
The USEK Library is equipped with four self-service Copy-Print-Scan (CPS) multifunction machines, available in Kaslik’s campus. Other facilities are available in the branch libraries.  
  
With the CPS system you can: 
  * Scan items directly to your email, free of charge (USEK users, alumni, and visitors).
  * Save your print jobs in the print queue for a maximum of four (4) hours until you release the order by swiping your credited USEK ID card at the printer station.
  * your materials after swiping your credited USEK ID card at the CPS station.


[4- Can I reserve a study room?](javascript:;)
You can book one of our two (2) fully equipped study rooms located in the Library. These study spaces are ideal for independent study, working with a partner for collaborative project work, or course work meetings.  
  
You can reserve a room online up to two (2) weeks in advance. Use this [link](https://www.usek.edu.lb/library/english/reserve-a-study-room2%20) to book your room.  
  
Check our [options and policies](https://www.usek.edu.lb/library/english/study-room-reservation-policy) for further details on available equipment and on how to use the rooms.

[1- When should I apply for NSSF?](javascript:;)
From September till the end of October of each year.
[2- How to apply to NSSF and what are the required documents?](javascript:;)
In case you should apply to the NSSF or not, you may yearly pass by the NSSF Office or send them an email on time.  
  
If you are already registered, you should bring the official documents (NSSF, COOP, Army, under the name of your parents, the company you work in, etc.)  
  
If you are not registered, you only need your national ID and a document proofing that you are not covered anymore if you were previously covered.
[3- What does the NSSF cover?](javascript:;)
If you are registered under the USEK NSSF, we cover hospitalization in (90%) and out (lab tests + medication 80%).
[4- If I already have a NSSF coverage, what should I do?](javascript:;)
You should present the proofing documents every year within the deadline mentioned on the [Academic Calendar](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar).
[5- Can I benefit from insurance?](javascript:;)
Yes, only if an accident happens on campus.
[6- Do I have to renew my NSSF profile every year?](javascript:;)
Yes. You should pass by the NSSF Office to renew it. Please refer to the [Academic Calenda](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/calendar)r for deadlines.
[7- What does the 94$ in the tuition fees stand for?](javascript:;)
This stands for the NSSF coverage under USEK’s name.

The IT User Support division is part of the **Enterprise IT Services (EITS) Department**. This IT division provides the front-line support (via phone, walk-in, and support ticket) for USEK community (students, faculty, and staff) on the use of the offered IT services for both on-campus and online activities. It is also the first point of contact for reporting incidents (e.g., when services are unavailable or malfunctioning) and service requests.

## Technology Transfer Office
### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/directors-word?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/mission-vision-goals?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/contact-us?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/faq?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/policies?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/forms?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/inventions-portfolio?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/ongoing-courses?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/academic-technology-transfer-process?parent=1)
### Mission
  * Educate and spread awareness regarding intellectual property, standard licensing practices, and the formation of new ventures.
  * Assist and lead the successful commercialization of innovations and research.
  * Protect and commercialize intellectual property generated at USEK.
  * Facilitate the transfer of technologies from the University to the industry, with the ultimate goal of creating a socio-economic impact.

  
  

### Vision
The vision of the USEK TTO is to create a future where invention, research, and technology will be given the opportunity to make a global impact.  
  

### Goals
  * Support the creation and growth of startup companies based on the institution's research and intellectual property. 
  * Bridge the gap between academic research and the commercial sector, to promote the development and commercialization of new technologies and products that have the potential to create socio-economic impact.

##  Overview 
![](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Content/Images/Uploaded%20Images/20190326AACSB.jpg)  
---  
![](https://www.usek.edu.lb/Content/Images/Uploaded%20Images/20231019PrimeLogo.jpg)  
The School was first founded in 1966, under the name of the Faculty of Business and Commercial Sciences and was considered as one of the pioneers in business education in the Near-East and was later, in 2018, renamed as the Business School.  
  
As part of USEK, it has dedicated itself, since its creation, to teach students how to administrate organizations, in the scope of sustainable development, while remaining devoted to its three-hundred years tradition of the Lebanese Maronite Order, a heritage conscientiously preserved and incessantly enriched.  
  
In 50 years, we have succeeded in providing local and regional markets with a wide range of specializations under the American Credit System in BBA, MBA and PhD.  
  
**Mission**  
We offer quality programs in business in a student centered environment, and help our students in achieving their goals. Through enriching multidisciplinary programs, we nurture an entrepreneurial spirit and graduate civically minded and ethically responsible professionals for the sustainable development of Lebanon and the region.  
  
The Business School consists of the following programs:   
  

### Undergraduate Programs
  * Bachelor of Business Administration  
Emphasis:  
- Audit  
- Finance – CFA®I Path  
- Business Computing  
- Management and Entrepreneurship  
- Marketing  
- Transport and Logistics 
  * Bachelor of Business Administration - International Hospitality and Tourism Management
  * Minor in Audit
  * Minor in Finance
  * Minor in International Hospitality and Tourism Management
  * Minor in Management and Entrepreneurship
  * Minor in Marketing

  

### Graduate Programs
  * Master of Business Administration   
Emphasis:  
- Audit  
- Finance  
- Marketing
  * Master of Business Administration-Management and International Affairs
  * Master of Business Administration - Human Resources
  * Master of Business Administration - Financial Engineering

  

### Doctoral
  * Ph.D. in Business

### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/directors-word?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/mission-vision-goals?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/contact-us?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/faq?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/policies?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/forms?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/inventions-portfolio?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/ongoing-courses?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/academic-technology-transfer-process?parent=1)
Welcome to our Technology Transfer Office (TTO)! We are dedicated to helping researchers and entrepreneurs turn their innovative ideas into successful businesses. Our team of experts is here to support you every step of the way, from protecting your intellectual property to bringing your products to market.  
Explore our website to learn more about our services. Please don't hesitate to reach out to us with any questions or ideas you may have. We look forward to working with you!  
  

### What is USEK TTO
USEK TTO provides training and educational programs to help researchers and students develop the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in the competitive world of technology commercialization.  
  
USEK works closely with local and international industry partners, investors, as well as government and legal agencies to identify new opportunities for technology transfer and invest in the development of new products/services benefiting the society.

##  General Education Requirements 
[Back](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/students)
### WHAT IS GENERAL EDUCATION?
Objective:  
The General Education program at USEK aims to provide students enrolled as undergraduates with value learning, intellectual inquiry and to cultivate particular skills to become thoughtful and engaged and active citizens of the country, the region and the world while bringing them to a critical and appreciative understanding of religious tradition, ethical theories and moral development.  
  
Composition:  
At least 30 credits of the undergraduate studies curriculum are devoted to General Education that includes basic general knowledge, common and proper to USEK, while taking into consideration that students who are enrolled in professional fields such as sciences and engineering should be exposed to the humanities and social sciences and students enrolled in humanities fields should be aware of natural sciences and quantitative reasoning.

### In this section
[](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/directors-word?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/mission-vision-goals?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/tto/contact-us?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/faq?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/policies?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/forms?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/inventions-portfolio?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/ongoing-courses?parent=1) [](https://www.usek.edu.lb/en/research/technology-transfer-office/academic-technology-transfer-process?parent=1)
Welcome to our Technology Transfer Office (TTO)! We are dedicated to helping researchers and entrepreneurs turn their innovative ideas into successful businesses. Our team of experts is here to support you every step of the way, from protecting your intellectual property to bringing your products to market.  
Explore our website to learn more about our services. Please don't hesitate to reach out to us with any questions or ideas you may have. We look forward to working with you!  
  

### What is USEK TTO
USEK TTO provides training and educational programs to help researchers and students develop the skills and knowledge they need to succeed in the competitive world of technology commercialization.  
  
USEK works closely with local and international industry partners, investors, as well as government and legal agencies to identify new opportunities for technology transfer and invest in the development of new products/services benefiting the society.

##  International Summer School 2025 
Discover Lebanon with USEK  
  
The USEK International Summer School, offers an enriching academic and cultural experience in the heart of Lebanon.  
Designed for international students, this two-week program aims to build bridges between cultures.  
  
Courses Offered:  
1. Arabic Crash Course  
2. Entrepreneurship and Startups in Lebanon  
3. Lebanese Heritage and Culture: A Journey Through Art, History, and Identity  
  

### Benefits
  * Academic Enrichment: Engage with dynamic courses that offer both theoretical insights and practical knowledge.
  * Cultural Immersion: Experience Lebanon through its rich traditions and vibrant social activities.
  * Global Networking: Connect with students and professionals from around the world.
  * Personal Growth: Develop skills that contribute to your academic and career aspirations.

  
  

### Program Details
Duration: **July 7 to 18, 2025**  
Cost: $1,500 (excluding travel, visa, accommodation, and insurance)  
Certificate: All participants receive a Certificate in Lebanese Heritage & Culture.  
  
[Click Here to Apply](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/login?redirect-to=/usek-international-summer-school-form/new)  
Registration is open until June 15, 2025. Limited spots available.  
  
For more information, kindly contact iao@usek.edu.lb or uclc@usek.edu.lb.  
  
Experience a summer like no other at USEK!  
Join us for an unforgettable journey at the USEK International Summer School 2025, and get culturally tanned.

##  Director's Word 
Dear Learners,  
  
It gives me great pleasure to welcome you to the USEK Continuing Learning Center (UCLC).   
  
Our mission is to provide you with the sustainable tools and resources you need to achieve your academic and professional goals.  
  
Learning is a lifelong process, and we strive to create a learning environment that is engaging, supportive, and accessible to all. Whether you are looking to enhance your skills, explore new topics, or advance your career, we are here to help.  
  
Our versatile, online, or on-campus courses are designed to be interactive and practical. We want you to be able to apply what you learn in real-world situations and see the impact of your new knowledge and skills. Our experienced instructors are passionate about their subjects and committed to providing you with high-quality instruction and mentorship to succeed in today’s rapidly changing world.  
  
We offer a wide range of career-oriented certification programs to meet your needs at all levels. Whether you are just starting out or looking to take your career to the next level, our flexible and accessible courses will help you learn at your own pace and on your own schedule.  
  
At UCLC, we value diversity, equity, and inclusion in a welcoming learning environment for all. Education is a journey, not a destination. Hence, everyone has the potential to learn and grow, and we are committed to supporting you every step of the way.  
  
As you embark on this new chapter of your career, I would like to share a quote that has always inspired me: _“The best investment you can make is an investment in yourself”_. – Warren Buffett  
  
Thank you for choosing the USEK Continuing Learning Center as your partner in lifelong learning.   
  
Sincerely,   
Lara Hanna-Wakim, PhD

##  Partnerships and Collaborations 
### Local
**  
FTL (Lebanon)**  
Fair Trade Lebanon (FTL) is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting fair trade principles and supporting small-scale Lebanese producers, cooperatives, and artisans. It aims to empower marginalized communities by providing them with access to local and international markets under equitable and sustainable conditions. FTL focuses on improving livelihoods, preserving traditional skills, and encouraging environmentally responsible practices. The organization advocates for social justice, transparency, and fairness in trade relationships, helping producers receive fair compensation for their work and fostering community development.  
**  
ACE Faction (Lebanon)**  
Founded in 2005, ACE Faction is a private establishment specializing in a wide range of scientific, technical, and managerial disciplines. As a consulting entity, training provider, laboratory testing service, and internal or second-party auditor, as well as a third-party inspection body, ACE Faction operates across multiple fields. Its approach is rooted in the values of independence, integrity, impartiality, and the expertise of its management and personnel.  
Dedicated to delivering improvement strategies and quality solutions, ACE Faction enhances business processes, ensuring compliance with national and international standards. The objective is to safeguard brand reputation, strengthen market positioning, and boost profitability, all while prioritizing consumer and environmental protection and ensuring customer satisfaction.  
  
**IFDS (Lebanon)**  
The International Face Design School (IFDS), based in Lebanon, is dedicated to providing high-level masterclasses and training programs in the beauty field. With a focus on excellence and innovation, IFDS provides specialized education in facial design, and other advanced beauty techniques, equipping professionals with the skills needed to thrive in this dynamic industry.  
  
**Ignite & Improve (Lebanon)**  
Ignite & Improve is a consultancy and training organization specializing in leadership development, professional growth, and business transformation. It typically targets professionals seeking to enhance their skill sets and organizations striving for efficiency and growth.   
With a vision of fostering a thriving community enriched with knowledge and united in the pursuit of prosperity, Ignite & Improve empowers individuals and organizations by unlocking their full potential. Guided by the core values of courage, confidence, and consistency, the organization is committed to delivering meaningful and lasting impact.  
  

### International
  
**International Authority for Professional Coaching & Mentoring (UK)**  
The International Authority for Professional Coaching & Mentoring (IAPCM), based in England, is a globally recognized authority dedicated to advancing the standards of coaching and mentoring. As the leading accreditation authority for professional coaches, mentors, training providers, and organizations with in-house coaching and mentoring teams, IAPCM upholds the highest industry standards  
With a mission to build confidence in coaching and mentoring, IAPCM provides independent, professional accreditation that reinforces trust and credibility in the field. Through a commitment to collaboration and integrity, the organization ensures that the benefits of coaching and mentoring are widely accessible, fostering professionalism and ethical practice across the industry.  
With this reputation, IAPCM is dedicated to offering members an exceptional return on investment, both personally and professionally, while fostering a supportive environment that empowers growth and success.  
**  
The American Foundation for Educational Excellence (USA)**  
The American Foundation for Educational Excellence (AFEE) is dedicated to promoting ethical practices and service leadership in collaboration with the International Society for Educational Excellence (ISEE). AFEE plays a pivotal role in supporting institutions striving to achieve accreditation, ensuring they meet the highest standards of educational quality and integrity.  
With a strong commitment to empowering women, AFEE collaborates with the International Foundation for Women’s Empowerment (IFWE) to create opportunities that drive women’s success and leadership on a global scale. Additionally, AFEE provides premier language education and professional services through its Center for Excellence in Languages (CEL), offering world-class resources for language development and professional growth.  
As an approved provider for HRCI and SHRM, AFEE ensures its programs align with the highest standards of professional development. Through these initiatives, AFEE remains committed to helping individuals and organizations achieve global excellence, fostering leadership, and promoting continuous learning across diverse fields.  
  
**Calliance Ltd (UK)**  
Calliance Ltd is a UK-based specialist company dedicated to Crisis Management response and Hostage & Crisis Negotiation learning and development. With a focus on equipping individuals and organizations with essential skills and knowledge to respond effectively in high-pressure situations, Calliance Ltd offers expert training and resources designed to enhance crisis preparedness and resolution.  
Through its tailored programs, Calliance Ltd ensures that clients are well-prepared to manage complex crises, negotiate successfully in hostage situations, and lead teams through critical challenges with confidence and precision. With a commitment to excellence and safety, the company plays a vital role in advancing crisis management practices globally, offering practical tools and insights that help professionals navigate and resolve critical incidents.  
  
**EUROCERT (Canada)**  
EUROCERT Inc. is a leading provider of auditing and certification services, specializing in sustainable development practices. With a commitment to improving management systems, EUROCERT helps organizations align with global sustainability goals by offering comprehensive auditing, certification, and support services. Fostering trust, integrity, and innovation across its operations, EUROCERT ensures that businesses meet high-quality standards while embracing corporate responsibility. Through its expert services, EUROCERT helps organizations enhance their effectiveness and efficiency, building long-term relationships that drive continuous improvement in sustainability and business performance.  
  
**Global Care Management Group (USA)**  
Global Care Management Group (GCMG) was established in the USA to provide a lasting foundation for the initiatives launched by the Global Care Medical Group in 2002. Supported by a team of leading international scientists and consultants, GCMG delivers a wide range of customer-focused specialist services through dynamic, certified, and highly skilled professionals.  
GCMG combines healthcare excellence with effective management to transform medical practices in today's dynamic healthcare landscape. The focus is on delivering innovative and streamlined solutions that enable healthcare providers to concentrate on delivering exceptional patient care. By offering comprehensive medical management services, GCMG aims to drive positive change and promote sustainability in the healthcare industry.

##  Ongoing Courses 
### MOUNEH MASTERCLASS: ENSURING QUALITY, SAFETY, AND MARKET SUCCESS
This course is designed for Mouneh producers seeking to enhance the quality, safety, and marketability of their traditional homemade products, in collaboration with the Federation of Keserwan Municipalities. Participants will gain practical skills in food preservation, safety standards, packaging, branding, and marketing strategies.  
The course integrates theory with hands-on learning, empowering producers to improve their crafts, meet industry standards, and expand their market presence. It also emphasizes community empowerment and local business growth, providing a valuable opportunity for producers to learn from experts and elevate their products to new levels of success.  
  
Instructor: **Dr. Antonio Khabbaz**  
Start date: June 26, 2025  
End date: June 27, 2025  
Schedule: Thursday and Friday | 9:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.  
Duration: 15 hours  
Delivery mode: On campus   
Course fees: 200 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- learn practical techniques in food preservation and hygiene to elevate the quality and safety of traditional homemade products.  
- master packaging and branding strategies to present products effectively and broaden market appeal.  
- understand essential food safety regulations to ensure products meet legal requirements and earn consumer trust.  
- develop actionable marketing tactics to expand market reach and drive business growth.  
- learn how to conduct product testing and prepare accurate nutritional labels, boosting consumer confidence.  
- strengthen market competitiveness through acquired skills, promoting long-term business sustainability and success.  
  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### ENGLISH SKILLS FOR SUSTAINABLE PURPOSES
This course addresses common challenges faced by learners of English as a foreign language. Aiming to familiarize the participants with the essential elements required to enhance their English language skills, the course emphasizes four key components: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. It includes a range of materials and activities, such as fundamental grammatical structures, vocabulary development, cross-cultural writing topics, as well as daily conversations and discussions.  
  
Instructor: **Ms. Nicole Richa**  
Start date: June 10, 2025  
End date: July 29, 2025  
Schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays | 6:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.  
Duration: 30 hours  
Delivery mode: On campus  
Course fees: 300 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- improve their listening, reading, and speaking skills, by listening to audio scripts, reading informative texts, and holding conversations on various topics.  
- master important grammatical rules and structures.  
- write structured essays and improve their writing skills.  
- practice professional language skills in the workplace.  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE MANAGEMENT
This course is designed to help participants understand and enhance customer experience by mapping the customer journey, applying user-centered design, using service design thinking, and developing effective loyalty strategies. Through real-world case studies, students will learn how to create customer-focused experiences that drive engagement and build brand loyalty.  
  
Instructor: **Dr. Nahed Rizk**  
Start date: June 16, 2025  
End date: July 14, 2025  
Schedule: Mondays and Wednesdays | 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.  
Duration: 15 hours  
Delivery mode: Hybrid  
Course fees: 200 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- map the customer journey to identify touchpoints that impact customer satisfaction and loyalty.   
- apply user-centered design principles to improve the usability and effectiveness of customer interactions.  
- use service design thinking to create seamless and meaningful customer experiences.   
- develop strategies that foster customer loyalty and enhance long-term engagement.   
- analyze customer feedback to continually improve and adapt customer experience strategies.  
- evaluate case studies to understand the successful application of customer experience management in diverse industries.  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### ADVANCED SKIN THERAPIES: SCIENCE AND PRACTICE
This intensive course provides a comprehensive education in advanced skincare science, paramedical aesthetics, and clinical treatment techniques. Learners will gain expertise in skin diagnostics, advanced treatment methodologies, and the latest technological innovations in skincare.  
The course mixes scientific research with hands-on practice, preparing learners to confidently diagnose and treat various skin conditions. Live demonstrations and interactive sessions ensure mastery of essential treatments, like HydraFacial, Radiofrequency Microneedling, Pico-Laser, and HIFU.  
  
Instructor: **Ms. Nathalie Nemer**  
Start date: June 16, 2025  
End date: July 22, 2025  
Schedule: Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays | 5:30 p.m. - 7:30 p.m.  
Duration: 35 Hours  
Delivery mode: International Face Design School (IFDS) – Hybrid  
Course fees: 850 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- demonstrate a deep understanding of skin anatomy, physiology, and conditions.  
- perform a professional skin diagnosis and recommend appropriate treatments.  
- master advanced skincare techniques and technologies.  
- conduct clinical-grade aesthetic treatments with confidence.  
- apply professional ethics, hygiene standards, and best practices in client consultations.  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### 3D MAX ESSENTIALS FOR ARCHITECTURAL DESIGN
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to 3D Max, a powerful tool in architectural design, offering advanced modeling, rendering, and animation capabilities. Through hands-on practice, learners will develop the skills to create detailed 3D models, apply realistic textures and materials, and implement dynamic lighting effects. By bridging the gap between conceptual design and real-world visualization, this course enhances creativity, spatial awareness, and problem-solving abilities, preparing participants for professional architectural presentations and design projects.  
  
Instructor: **Mr. Elie Abi Safi**  
Start date: June 14, 2025  
End date: August 2, 2025  
Schedule: Saturdays | 10:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.  
Duration: 30 hours  
Delivery mode: On campus  
Course fees: 350 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- model detailed 3D architectural structures from scratch.  
- apply realistic materials, textures, and lighting effects.  
- render high-quality visuals and animations for presentations.  
- enhance their ability to experiment with design elements and spatial arrangements.  
- develop essential skills for architectural visualization, preparing them for careers in architecture, interior design, and urban planning.  
  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### SMART MEDICINE: HOW AI IS TRANSFORMING PATIENT CARE
This course is designed to introduce healthcare professionals to the transformative role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in modern healthcare systems. Participants will gain a deep understanding of AI applications, tools, and strategies for successful integration in hospitals. Through real-life case studies, actionable steps, and discussions on the benefits and challenges, the course empowers staff to embrace AI confidently and effectively, ensuring better patient care and operational excellence.  
  
Instructor: **Dr. Colonel Suzan Hajj**  
Start date: July 17, 2025  
End date: August 28, 2025  
Schedule: Thursdays | 3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.  
Duration: 15 hours  
Delivery mode: In person at NDS University Hospital  
Course fees: 200 USD  
  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- understand the fundamentals of AI and its relevance to healthcare.  
- explore practical AI applications and tools currently transforming healthcare.  
- identify key roles and stakeholders involved in AI integration.  
- learn actionable steps to prepare for AI adoption in hospitals.  
- evaluate the benefits and challenges of implementing AI in healthcare.   
- analyze real-life case studies to inspire innovation in their own organizations.  
- envision the future of AI and its potential to revolutionize healthcare delivery.  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
  

### FACE DESIGN PROGRAM
The Face Design Program is a registered program adapted to all levels and designed for beginner to advanced-level beauticians, skin therapists, PMU/SPMU professionals, tattoo artists, and all beauticians. Extensive knowledge, backed by science and studies, along with experience and worldwide practice, describes the latest techniques in the PMU industry. The program covers microblading, micropigmentation, ombre shading, laser tattoo removal, Rejuvi tattoo removal, lips nano-pigmentation, lip blush, Infralash eyeliner, colorimetry, shaping, face mapping using the diamond technique, patterns, skin types, skin issues and other factors affecting end results and their corresponding treatments, in addition to a variety of techniques, machines, and product ingredients/composition. It is your basic guide to becoming a knowledgeable practitioner offering reliant skin diagnoses and therapies.  
Live demonstrations will teach you to master hand and body positions to become a confident aesthetician who will offer their own live demonstration by the end of the program.  
  
Instructor: **Ms. Nathalie Nemer**  
Start date: August 11, 2025  
End date: August 27, 2025  
Schedule: Mondays to Thursdays | 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.  
Duration: 33 hours  
Delivery mode: International Face Design School (IFDS)  
Course fees: 1,200 USD  
Learning Outcomes  
Upon completion of the course, learners will be able to:  
- gain a comprehensive knowledge of the PMU industry, including safe removal procedures.  
- become a distinguished beauty practitioner.  
- work confidently and directly in the field.  
  

[ Register Now ](https://apply.usek.edu.lb/academic-applications)
